note: Captured once from the published effect-dynamodb@1.39.0 and @1.40.0 (with @effect-dynamodb/schema at the same version and effect@4.1.2), installed outside the repo and run by a scratch script against DynamoDB Local: never regenerate or "fix" it. For each shape of helpers/AggregateDiscriminatorRead.ts `opaqueShapes`: create, its requests (the table name as <table>) and the rows after it, get, a no-op update, its requests and rows, and get again. Values whose schema can not be seen into (a declaration, a transformation, a union with a declaration member) under a sub-aggregate bound with { side: 1 }, two that can (a suspended Unknown, a union of a struct and Unknown), and values on an aggregate keyed under PK with the collection sort key mirrored in csk. 1.39.0 did what 1.40.0 did for every shape.
